note: Friday 23 Oct 2026, 07:0x SGT run, before Asia's open (Thursday 22 Oct US close). VIX spiked +9.94% to 19.03 and the 10-year yield fell sharply to ~4.96-4.97% as an oil-driven inflation scare (Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure) and a re-ignited AI-capex-financing doubt (CoreWeave debt, Tesla capex cut, Meta non-voting shares) hit sentiment together. Fear&Greed reads Extreme Fear (20) despite NYSE breadth actually holding up (~1.45:1 advancers) -- a narrow, mega-cap-AI-concentrated selloff rather than a broad one. CNN's own Fear&Greed page returned an access error this run; the headline value was cross-checked against a mirror explicitly dated 2026-10-22. BofA/EPFR global fund-flow data has not rolled forward past week-ended-Oct-14 as of this run.
